rules.rationale: Appraisal workflow predicates execute in the PROforma runtime.
Finite, ground predicate; PROforma three-valued evaluation is sufficient.
Plan preconditions and eligibility execute in the PROforma runtime.
Task preconditions execute in the PROforma runtime.
Routing eligibility is a finite PROforma predicate.
Template preconditions are finite PROforma predicates.
Interacting symbolic numeric bounds require solver proof.
Opposing assertions require scoped satisfiability analysis.
Symbolic implication must be proven over declared constraints.
Identity, presence and allow-list checks are directly decidable.
Lineage completeness is a finite reference/shape check.
